dialog.about.body.source: Explore stitch order, thread colors, jumps, trims, and machine commands before production. Preview the design stitch by stitch, switch rendering styles, and export what you see.
dialog.about.body.translation: Ordinem punctorum, colores fili, saltus, sectiones fili atque imperata machinae ante confectionem explora. Formam punctum post punctum praevide, modos reddendi commuta atque ea quae vides exporta.

dialog.about.tagline.source: Interactive embroidery simulation, inspection, and export.
dialog.about.tagline.translation: Simulatio, inspectio atque exportatio intertexturae acu pictae.

dialog.calibrate.info.source: Hold a ruler against the screen and drag the slider until the bar below is exactly 100 mm long, then press OK.
dialog.calibrate.info.translation: Regulam adhibe ad imaginem in velo et labrum trahe, donec regula infra prorsus 100 mm longa sit; deinde OK preme.

dialog.export.copy.tooltip.source: Copy the full-resolution image to the clipboard
dialog.export.copy.tooltip.translation: Imaginem plenae resolutionis in tabulam communicationis exscribe

dialog.export.save.tooltip.source: Save the image to a file

dialog.language.restart_message.source: The language has been set to {language}. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.restart_message.translation: Lingua in {language} mutata est. Nuncne InkSim iterum incipias, ut mutatio valeat?

dialog.language.system_default_message.source: The system default language will be used. Restart InkSim now to apply it?
dialog.language.system_default_message.translation: Lingua quae in systemate praescripta est adhibebitur. Nuncne InkSim iterum incipias, ut mutatio valeat?

dialog.language.windows_closed.source: All open InkSim windows will be closed and the current file reopened.
dialog.language.windows_closed.translation: Omnes fenestrae InkSim apertae claudentur et fasciculus praesens denuo aperietur.

dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.source: See output.err for the error details.
dialog.open_browser.conversion_hint.translation: Vide output.err ut causam erroris cognoscas.

dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.source: Open this SVG in a new Inkscape window.
dialog.open_browser.edit_hint.translation: Hoc SVG in nova fenestra Inkscape aperi.

dialog.open_browser.empty.source: No supported files in this folder.
dialog.open_browser.empty.translation: Nulli fasciculi apti in hoc indice.

dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_hint.translation: Indicem duplici ictu aperi, ut fasciculos eius perlustres.

dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.source: Double-click the folder to browse its files.
dialog.open_browser.folder_open_hint.translation: Indicem duplici ictu aperi, ut fasciculos eius perlustres.

dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.source: Inkscape is required to edit SVG files.
dialog.open_browser.inkscape_required.translation: Inkscape requiritur ad fasciculos SVG emendandos.

dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.source: A configured Ink/Stitch installation and Python launcher are required.
dialog.open_browser.inkstitch_required.translation: Institutio Ink/Stitch configurata et programma Python requiruntur.

dialog.open_browser.not_embroidery.translation: Fasciculus intertexturae acu pictae non valet

dialog.open_browser.open_hint.translation: Fasciculum intertexturae acu pictae delectum aperi.

dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.source: Generate stitch data from this SVG with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.preview_hint.translation: Ex hoc SVG data punctorum per Inkscape/Ink/Stitch crea.

dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.source: Cannot run the active Ink/Stitch script or its configured Python launcher.
dialog.open_browser.preview_unavailable.translation: Scriptum Ink/Stitch activum aut programma Python configuratum currere non potest.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.source: Ink/Stitch extension: could not check. Use Tools... to retry.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_che.translation: Extensio Ink/Stitch: explorari non potuit. Instrumentis... utere ut iterum temptes.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not found in Inkscape's extension directories.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_mis.translation: Extensio Ink/Stitch: in indicibus extensionum Inkscape non inventa.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.source: Ink/Stitch extension: cannot check until Inkscape is configured.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_no_.translation: Extensio Ink/Stitch: explorari non potest antequam Inkscape configuretur.

dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.source: Ink/Stitch extension: not checked yet. Use Tools... to check.
dialog.open_browser.status.inkstitch_unc.translation: Extensio Ink/Stitch: nondum explorata. Instrumentis... utere ad explorandum.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.source: SVG source. Inkscape is required for stitch preview.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_needs_in.translation: Fons SVG. Inkscape ad praevisionem punctorum requiritur.

dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.source: SVG source. Choose Preview to generate stitch data with Inkscape/Ink/Stitch.
dialog.open_browser.svg_caption_ready.translation: Fons SVG. Elige Praevide ut data punctorum per Inkscape/Ink/Stitch crees.

dialog.open_browser.svg_invalid.source: The SVG could not be rendered.

dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.source: This SVG is too large to preview here.
dialog.open_browser.svg_too_large.translation: Hoc SVG praevideri non potest, quia nimis magnum est.

dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.source: Could not create a temporary preview file: {error}
dialog.open_browser.temp_file_failed.translation: Fasciculus temporarius praevisionis creari non potuit: {error}

dialog.open_browser.unsupported.source: This file type cannot be opened in InkSim.
dialog.open_browser.unsupported.translation: Hoc genus fasciculi in InkSim aperiri non potest.

integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.source: Could not save the Inkscape extension status: {error}
integration.inkscape.config_save_failed.translation: Status extensionis Inkscape servari non potuit: {error}

integration.inkscape.inksim_none.source: No InkSim extension folders were found.
integration.inkscape.inksim_none.translation: Nulli indices extensionum InkSim inventi sunt.

integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.inksim_scan_failed.translation: Indices extensionum Inkscape explorari non potuerunt: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: Could not install InkSim's Inkscape extensions: {error}
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Extensiones InkSim pro Inkscape institui non potuerunt: {error}

integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.source: InkSim's Inkscape extensions were installed or updated in {path}. Restart Inkscape to load them.
integration.inkscape.install_extensions_.translation: Extensiones InkSim in {path} institutae aut renovatae sunt. Inkscape iterum incipe ut eas oneretur.

integration.inkscape.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found on the system path.
integration.inkscape.not_found.translation: Inkscape in via systematis non inventum est.

integration.inkscape.probe_failed.source: Could not read Inkscape extension directories: {error}
integration.inkscape.probe_failed.translation: Indices extensionum Inkscape legi non potuerunt: {error}

integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the new Python interpreter.
integration.inkscape.python_interpreter_.translation: Inkscape iterum incipe ut novus interpretator Python valeat.

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Could not remove the old InkSim extension folder: {error}
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Index vetus extensionum InkSim removeri non potuit: {error}

integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.source: Old InkSim extension folders were removed. Restart Inkscape to refresh its extension list.
integration.inkscape.remove_old_extensio.translation: Indices veteres extensionum InkSim remoti sunt. Inkscape iterum incipe ut indicem extensionum renovet.

integration.inkscape.report.config_save_.source: Could not save the InkSim configuration: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.source: Saved the detected setup to the InkSim configuration.
integration.inkscape.report.config_saved.translation: Configuratio InkSim ex institutione detecta servata est.

integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.source: Could not inspect Inkscape extension folders: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.inksim_scan_.translation: Indices extensionum Inkscape explorari non potuerunt: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found; the preference was left unchanged.
integration.inkscape.report.launcher_mis.translation: Programma necessarium '{command}' non inventum est; praeferentia immutata est.

integration.inkscape.report.not_found.source: Inkscape was not found. Choose its executable to inspect the setup.
integration.inkscape.report.not_found.translation: Inkscape non inventum est. Elige eius programma ut configurationem explores.

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Could not check or update the Python interpreter: {error}
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Interpretator Python explorari aut mutari non potuit: {error}

integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.source: Python interpreter preference was not checked because the user extensions directory is unavailable.
integration.inkscape.report.preferences_.translation: Praeferentia interpretatoris Python non explorata est, quia index extensionum usoris inaccessibilis est.

integration.inkscape.report.restart.source: Restart Inkscape to apply the updated interpreter.
integration.inkscape.report.restart.translation: Inkscape iterum incipe ut interpretator renovatus valeat.

integration.inkscape.report.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds.

integration.inkscape.report.waiting.source: Choose an Inkscape executable to inspect.
integration.inkscape.report.waiting.translation: Elige programma Inkscape ut configurationem explores.

integration.inkscape.timeout.source: Inkscape did not respond within {seconds} seconds. Another Inkscape instance or an extension may be blocking communication. Close other Inkscape instances or disable the blocking extension, then try again.
integration.inkscape.timeout.translation: Inkscape intra {seconds} secundas non respondit. Alia Inkscape exemplaria vel extensio communicatio prohibere potest. Claude alia Inkscape exemplaria aut extensionem impedientem destrue, deinde iterum tenta.

integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.source: Required launcher '{command}' was not found. Install the uvr tool yourself with `uv tool install uvr`, then run this configuration again. InkSim will not install it.
integration.inkscape.uvr_missing.translation: Programma necessarium '{command}' non inventum est. Instrue ipse instrumentum uvr per `uv tool install uvr`, deinde hanc configurationem iterum fac. InkSim illud non instituet.

message.no_file_to_export.source: No embroidery file is loaded to export.
message.no_file_to_export.translation: Nullus fasciculus intertexturae acu pictae exportandus oneratus est.

message.no_file_to_save.translation: Nullus fasciculus intertexturae acu pictae servandus oneratus est.

status.line_settings.reset.source: Reset line width and shading factors
status.line_settings.reset.translation: Latitudinem lineae et factores umbrarum restitue

status.line_settings.tooltip.source: Click to adjust dark factor, light factor and line width
status.line_settings.tooltip.translation: Clicca ut factorem obscurum, factorem lucidum et latitudinem lineae componas

status.mode.bottom_view.source: Bottom view (draw later stitches under earlier ones)
status.mode.bottom_view.translation: Aspectus inferior (puncta posteriora sub prioribus ducuntur)

status.mode.jump.source: Cycle jump display: off, all, risky only
status.mode.jump.translation: Ostensionem saltus commuta: nulla, omnes, periculosi tantum
